message.content:
The discriminant \(D\) is  

\[
D = b^{\,2}-4ac = 2^{2}-4(1)(3)=4-12=-8 .
\]

Since \(D<0\), the roots are complex:

\[
x=\frac{-b \pm \sqrt{D}}{2a}
   =\frac{-2 \pm \sqrt{-8}}{2}
   =\frac{-2 \pm i\,\sqrt{8}}{2}
   =-1 \;\pm\; i\,\sqrt{2}.
\]

Hence the two solutions are  

\[
\boxed{x_1 = -1+i\sqrt{2}}, \qquad 
\boxed{x_2 = -1-i\sqrt{2}}\,.
